Message:
It’s nothing more than a hunch,
but assuming that were true,
I should be able to
figure out the identity of
the one who destroyed it.

The witch who wields
that so-called holy sword
said as much.
Worlds can’t be destroyed,
even by the likes of demons.

Unless it was done by some
“god of destruction”...

After all, based on what
I’ve seen and heard so far,
no world has ever been
destroyed by a demon directly.

In that case...
just why was that
angel’s world destroyed?

...“The Divine Oak that
descended from Heaven—
the ‘Staff of Tikkun’...”
Is it because
Samyaza created that?

Or, was it punishment
for favoring their beloved
humans too much?

Being punished for just that
does seem fairly petty, though...
Unless...there was
some other reason?

Like an act God believed
His angel Samyaza had done
in rebellion against Him—
